concurrency.owner_key: operator git identity + target final SHA + freshly FETCHED REMOTE notes-ref tip OID (lease value read via git fetch origin refs/notes/svc-receipts immediately before each attempt)
concurrency.concurrent_invoke_behavior: Fetches the remote notes tip, JSON-merges only its own slot into that fetched envelope, then publishes refs/notes/svc-receipts via git push --force-with-lease=refs/notes/svc-receipts:<fetched-remote-tip-OID>. A concurrent writer (same or different host) advances the remote tip; the loser's lease fails as non-fast-forward, it re-fetches, re-merges its slot into the fresh tip, and retries bounded at 5 attempts with linear backoff. Overwriting a foreign tip never occurs; exhaustion reports MERGED_UNVERIFIED naming the losing slot. The flock lock is same-host coordination only; cross-host safety rests entirely on the fetched-tip lease.
concurrency.stale_lock_cleanup: Per-target-SHA advisory lock file $(git rev-parse --git-common-dir)/svc-locks/<final-sha>.lock held via flock for the envelope read-modify-write window. The OS releases flock when the holder process exits or crashes, so orphaned holders self-heal on the next acquisition; no janitor process exists.
concurrency.concurrency_test: test-framework/evals/tier-1/validate-skill-coverage.sh scenario S5: two concurrent emitters race one CAS update on a disposable repo; exactly one loses the lease, retries after re-merge, and BOTH slots survive in the final envelope.

external_writer.immutable_baseline: .svc/receipts/pre-coverage/<final-sha>-envelope.json — write-once copy of the complete envelope bytes read before the first coverage mutation; the finalizer never rewrites this file.
external_writer.rolling_rollback: refs/notes/svc-receipts-backup/<rfc3339-ts> — notes ref created before any recovery mutation; restore procedure re-publishes this ref over refs/notes/svc-receipts (distinct from the immutable baseline file).
external_writer.read_failure_policy: Absence versus corruption is probed PER OBJECT: git notes --ref=svc-receipts show <final-sha> failing AND git notes --ref=svc-receipts list <final-sha> returning empty means genuinely absent for this object (initialize-empty allowed with provenance recorded in envelope_provenance); any other read failure (corrupt JSON, git errors) aborts with MERGED_UNVERIFIED. Ref-level health is checked separately once via git rev-parse refs/notes/svc-receipts.
external_writer.file_mode_preservation: n/a — targets are Git object-store artifacts (blobs and notes refs), not working-tree files; git preserves object modes internally.

resource_review.evidence: Census recomputed by validate-plan-contract on every run against base_sha; planning-state tree contains zero changed executable files (manifest/WI/lane-tasks are .md/.json); at CP-PRELAND inside the worktree the denominator is updated to the post-execution census and disposition re-evaluated.
